why: MDPI sets its Abbreviations glossary as an <array> whose rows sit in a <tbody> with no <table> around them. Read as prose, the terms ran together ("EDElbow dysplasiaDJD…") and every row and cell was reported unhandled; the array is a table. 6 tables: 5 <table-wrap> and the glossary array.
title: Assessment of Elbow Joint Incongruity as a Primary Cause of Canine Elbow Dysplasia: Comparative Imaging Analysis Using CT and Radiography in 108 Dogs—A Retrospective Study
abstractStartsWith: Background: Incongruity is a primary cause of elbow dysplasia.
